summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload with it
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the platform-specific binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the bundled local file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~728KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle with a rotated string-array decoder and hex-obfuscated identifiers; it is not referenced from the library's main entry (dist/index.cjs) and performs no math functionality. Executing an obfuscated bundled file via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at install time bypasses Node-based scanning and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine. The package is published under the @servicetitan npm scope and its README links to servicetitan.atlassian.net JIRA tickets, presenting as internal ServiceTitan tooling for an ECharts theme, which is inconsistent with fetching a language runtime and executing an obfuscated payload with it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
